name: claw-kit
description:
[claw host]
platform: cindy
Host/session identity remains adapter-owned, independent of model/provider. Workflow tools and explicit shared skill installation. Use standard global skill names (for example planning).
whenToUse: 每个 Cindy 会话启动时的 claw-kit 流程入口，以及已有计划恢复、任务推进与收口。公共入口技能名为 using-claw-kit。

tools.name: skills_status
tools.description:
[claw host]
platform: cindy
Host identity is independent of model/provider. Check shared skills locally without network access. Installation and current-session loading are separate.

tools.name: install_skills
tools.description:
[claw host]
platform: cindy
Host identity is independent of model/provider. Explicitly install/update complete global @veewo/claw-skills at this plugin's pinned version. Downloads from npm only on this call; preserves user files. Requires a local writable session. Start a new session afterwards.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description:
[claw host]
platform: cindy
Adapter-owned host identity, independent of model/provider or skill path. Host/session arguments remain adapter-owned.
List the available claw-kit workflow operations. Omit category for an overview, or pass a category to see operation names, descriptions, and argument schemas.

category.description: Optional operation category returned by a previous overview.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description:
[claw host]
platform: cindy
Adapter-owned host identity, independent of model/provider or skill path. Host/session arguments remain adapter-owned.
Run one claw-kit workflow operation in the current Cindy session. Use a name returned by list_tools and pass only that operation''s JSON arguments; Cindy supplies the session and workspace identity.
